levels.label: Parent/child trace
levels.allowed_claim: A declared workflow can record named child steps under one parent identity.
levels.forbidden_inference: The trace includes every process or external side effect.

levels.label: Partial failure and omission
levels.allowed_claim: A failed child preserves earlier results, marks later work not-run, and names omitted capture classes.
levels.forbidden_inference: The workflow completed or was safely recovered.

levels.label: Gateboard handoff
levels.allowed_claim: The trace envelope leaves a seam for a declared gate producer.
levels.forbidden_inference: Workflow Gateboard has emitted or consumed this exact trace.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The recorder case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
